title: MailBurner
description: A throwaway receive-only address on OpenVibe.Mail. It expires after ten minutes, an hour, a day or a week, or after the first message when first_message_only is set. When it expires its mail is deleted and the address bounces. A ten-minute burner may be made without an account (owner is null) and is then read with the one-time token the create call returns; the token is deliberately not part of this resource.

id.description: The burner id. Opaque outside OpenVibe.Mail.

owner.description: The Network subject id of the person who made the burner, or null for a ten-minute burner made without an account.

address.description: The burner address: eight unguessable characters on one of the rotating burner domains.

expires_at.description: When the address stops resolving and its mail is due for deletion, ISO 8601 UTC.

first_message_only.description: When true the burner accepts one message and then stops resolving.

created_at.description: When the burner was made, ISO 8601 UTC.
